title: Preferences: the user's own file
description: The shape of the user's own preferences file (~/.config/morndo-knowledge/preferences.yaml), never shipped with anyone's content: each entry is shown as its holder's preference, never as a fact (K4, K12). Morndo's parsePreferences is the authority: it holds every rule here, and one a schema can't say, that no two entries share an id.

id.description: What an SOP step cites: pref:<id>. Unique in the file.

holder.description: Whose view it is, not blank; principal is shown as "your".

on.description: When they said it: a real date, YYYY-MM-DD (the pattern holds each month's days and the leap years).

tasks.description: The SOP steps it speaks to, none blank.
